detail.title: Work robot and work system
detail.abstract: This work robot sequentially holds a plurality of workpieces supplied to a supply area and moves the held workpieces to a working area. This work robot comprises: an image-capturing device that captures images of the plurality of workpieces supplied to the supply area in random orientations and positions; an image processing device that recognizes a plurality of workpiece regions from the images captured by the image-capturing device, obtains the area and position of each of the recognized plurality of workpiece regions, and also obtains the distance between each of the workpiece regions and the working area or the work robot; and a control device that determines the order of holding the workpieces on the basis of the area of the plurality of workpiece regions and the distance to the working area or the work robot as obtained by the image processing device.
